added: Upgrade items to just right click a safe to upgrade it instead of needing to break them first to use in crafting.
changed: Doors can now be renamed like the safes.
fixed: Door issue with not dropping items. Doors now drop the item when broken.

added: Added a door that locks just like the safes do.
The doors can also give off a redstone signal when used without the key just like the safes.
Safes now emit a redstone signal when trying to open with the wrong key so you can set up an alarm/trap system for them.
changed: No longer uses a command to make a key. You craft unbound keys and right click your safe to bind it.
Crafting recipes have changed making them easier to make but still balanced.
fixed: Vault safe breaking texture for the top block is fixed.
knownIssues: There are some texture issues with the Vault safe that are being looked into.

changed: Vault safe is now a 2 block tall safe.
Bank safe is now a 2x2x2 safe.
knownIssues: There are some texture issues with the Vault safe that are being looked into.

added: Core secure storage system, first safe blocks, key/ownership foundation.
New upgrade: The Autosmelter Core.

changed: Hub + sorter are now compatable with inventories from mods such as sophisticated storage.

added: Autocrafter Core (crafts items in your whitelist if the materials are in the hub chest).
Keychain Module (lets you add 9 more hub keys to a sorter — right click with the upgrade in hand to open).
Stack Booster (increases the stack number of transferred items).
Speed Coil (increases the speed at which items get transferred).
Note: Speed Coil and Stack Booster are stackable up to 8 per stack to increase the effectiveness of the upgrade.
Hub + sorter framework and basic linking.
Sorrow system that builds over time while cursed.
Environmental decay effects that intensify as sorrow rises.
Light sources (torches, lanterns, etc.) can flicker or dim when sorrow is high.
Villagers react to cursed players by stepping back instead of taking damage.
Passive mobs take damage over time near high-sorrow players.
Bandages that suppress sorrow growth (temporary relief, not a cure).
Golden Bandages that allow solo cleansing (ritual still required).
Cleansing ritual at midnight using Crying Obsidian + a wooden altar + candles.
